author: Joe Scott
description:
Check out the Pressure Changes Everything line at https://laughsmarter.com/collections/pressure-changes-everything

In today’s Lightning Round video, we talk about the world’s history of extinction events and ask how long do we - statistically - have before it happens again. Also do some YouTube talk, debate why aliens would come here, and look at a megatsunami that rippled across the Earth for 9 days. In 2023.
